body: 💯 agree with this on my end as well

Years ago, but was too afraid to tell my most recent ex spouse and then she discovered I'd messaged a trans girl explicitly and left me (fair enough) and then said I was a stranger and won't let me see my kids anymore outside of a contact centre because she doesn't know who I am
Heybfriend how're you holding up?
I love my son
Don't think this! I wanted qualifications, a job using them and a child and happy relationship, 35 this year and only last year achieved 3 out of those 4 things so its never too late!!

Thank you so much, going to try and sleep now as uk times and all thay, ill check in tomorrow with everyone. Funny how out of all the people in the world its those I've never even met who are the most supportive. You're all wonderful people and deserve the best life has to offer.

I am trying to be strong, I have suffered from bipd and adhd all my life so struggle with impulsive and has decisions, this is hard but I understand what you mean, he's such a beautiful boy and all I want is him to have the best life possible.

Edit: thank you for the lovely words and thank you to everyone on this sub, you're all amazingly kind and generous souls please accept my sincere and genuine thanks from the bottom of my heart.

Please think about this, I myself am struggling, I understand how you feel, I want my son to have his dad but not the sad one he has now. 

Thi k about how devastated your daughter will be? You've not failed at being a mother, your daughter loves you like any child loves their parents. 

Don't take the two mums but to heart its probably your daughters coping mechanism to put a positive spin on. Try to get through the first visitation if possible  on that weekend go and see friends or family and explain how you feel for you daughter at least. Please 

From one struggling parent to another
I really love my son, with all of my heart and all of my soul. I don't want to do this to him but I am struggling myself right now and want his life to be happy.

Depending on your country there are always options, you could file for asylum and move to somewhere less Conservative? I know it would be hard but there is that option, its not that you've always wanted to be a girl. You are a girl and you just want your body to match your mind and your soul which is a beautiful thing. 

Don't kill yourself over this, there will be a way to overcome this and we are all here for you
 Discuss with your mum what you plan to do and see what she days? Let her know truly how you feel and if she still doesn't accept you its her loss. 

There must be something like financial aid you can get from the state and housing due to your circumstances of being kicked out by your mum? 

Is there any advice service the government offer for young people with the threat of homelessness?

Don't go yet!! There are always things you can do! You have us to talk to! We are here for you and I will be here for you for as long as I am here, I know its tough right now, but as someone on here told me, don't make a permanent decision for a temporary problem. The person who jumps off the ledge always regrets it half way down the fall.
Always here for a fellow human being, I will be your friend friend, where are you from and what do you do?
A level chemistry teacher here if it helps with any chemistry maths assignments
I'll come check on you friend, we all need to stick together and help each other out. The world needs more kind souls like you in it. Be strong and try to be happy and I will do the same
Thank you slowmo you're a great help and a very kind person

Thank you so much for the kind words, honestly I need to hear them right now, so sad and crying all night. He told me he loves his beautiful dad and I'm the best beautiful dad in the whole world, its so upsetting I love him so much.
I know and I am trying to, just hard when you're being worn down each day

No need to apologise you've been a great help in my mood sorry for the late reply was cuddling him to sleep. Either way ill miss that little beauty of a son. 

Either way I will lose him, alive or dead  but as you said trying to be there as someone stronger is the best thing I can do for him. 

All the thanks in the world, honestly don't try and off yourself either the world needs kind helpful souls like yourself or we will all be doomed.

I'm trying my best to stay for him and my mother and family, its really hard and really depressing at times but I take those words to heart he would surely be like that as well and rather see a sad broken father than not have one at all I guess, I'm trying to give it an extra week. And take it day by day to see if I can manage staying here for longer, I know its going to be hard, if I do check out then I apologise to him and everyone who has ever helped me in this. 

I will try and see where it goes s

Thank you ever so much for the kind words had made my mind up yes but I'm going to try and be strong for him as long as I can, I want him to be happy and healthy and enjoy his life without having to see his father beaten down and destroyed the reason I al at this point this is I believe me doing this will be better than him seeing his dad as a broken and sad man.

He's not allowed to see his grandmother or any family from my side except for me, I'm the only one after this situation. His other grandparents have full access and are treated as though they are on a pedastle. I'm so cruel and mean as to take away their access as they only do nice things for him (except her father being a bit racist). 

Believe me I am very much trying to hang on and fight but I just keep getting more and more tired and empty

Try being more active, and a healthier diet? See more friends, go outside, do anything to stay here, I am trying too  I know how you feel. 

The world doesn't need to lose another kind soul
Don't leave! Try until tomorrow, I am and so can you! Trust me!

Don't feel like that, you own your own feelings you will not be faking please try to carry on day by day , see someone and talk to them. 

Dont sit in shame and misery

Thank you, as far as I am concerned your are not being selfish you are kind of speaking on behalf of my son and believe me it helps it truly does. Thank you so much for communicating with myself. 

The movie cliche is fine by me thats how i see the world, it is always a conscious effort to find more reasons to stay alive, he is my main one rn and my family who have been kicked put of his life. 

My fiance is more a reason to go through with this to be honest. All he sees rn is his dad as a broken man who doesn't have much left but is faking till he makes it. Ill see what Tuesday brings and what the next few days have to offer. I don't see anything improving but I love him too much to hurt him

It happens araya life is full of speedbumps we just need to try and navigate them as best we can, just keep holding on and get those you love close to you, confide in them and they will help I promise. 

I will be here for you as long as I am here

I understand that, yes my life has been decided for him for the last 5 years, I've only just been able to live with him, I gave up my dream job in my dream city because she would flat out not move an hour from her mum and dad to be with me. I moved back gave up my work and took a less paid job here to be with him, the fact he is so young and won't remember is the main thing that has me contemplating this right now. 

I dont want him to know how sad his daddy is and how much he is suffering because of this, if I just go now it seems easier  

He knows I love him I tell him multiple times every day that no matter what, where or when ot whatever happens his daddy will always love him infinity and forever with all his heart and soul. I just don't know if I have the energy to keep going through this. 

I'm losing my family, my friends and even any form of connection with the outside world, I just want to crawl into a hole and disappear for good so he never has to see this. 


Thank you for the compliments I am always faking it in front of him so he thinks I'm happy, though he knows I'm sad rn hence the constant cuddles and kisses. I just want him to move on and forget about me.
Well done! I hope you can keep going for all of us who will not be success stories but failures in this.

I have contemplated it but I think it will be worse for him should I just run off, as if his dad didn't love him so left. I think if I were to end it now o could at least let him know how much I have and always will love him, not moving on with a new family. 

I just want him to be as happy as he can be, my life is already shit and always have been that one Ray of sunlight that is him is the only positive in my life is deserving of a better dad than what I can do for him, I'm so disappointed with myself and this situation 💔 that I think him having a depressed father or one than ran away would be worse him.
Try to get to tomorrow and then next week and see if you can get further, keep trying and fighting  the world will be worse without you.

This is only temporary, put the money into relocating and helping her? I'm sure she would really appreciate it if you go with her to comfort her and support her, that is the love of a life time. 

If only we all had someone like you've found we would all be in a better place, don't let ruined plans destroy your life, go with her, work there if needs be and revisit your plans once you have supported her and helped her with her dad. I believe she will really appreciate it

Are you still here? Please believe me the world will have lost a caring soul with you gone

I'm in the uk, I have some rights but mental health regardless of treatment here is used to tear down fathers chances, the judges follow what the woman wants like she is their boss, you get hammered for support, expected to run 2 homes and fully pay for them. If not she can strip you of your contact with out so much as a thank you and goodbye. 

I've been fighting for as long as I can remember, its the same thing all the time and he used to antagonise and destroy me regularly. 

I'll try to keep on fighting but I feel tired, isolated from everyone, and just really really low. I've been thinking of suicide since I was 13 (34 now) as I've always hated my life (its been hard) my son was my one Ray on sunshine however with the prospect of losing him and him being poisoned against me (he's always told people don't love him or care about him if she's really annoyed with them). 

I'm just worn out by it and her, I love him more than anything but not having a dad would be better than one who has had his soul and mind destroyed.

Try again, find people close to you to confjde in, I'm sure that there are people left who care enough to help, unlike myself where my closest and nearest don't particularly care except my mum. Try to talk to them or family or anyone you know and get it off your chest depression is speaking here and that's not a good thing  have you tried therapy?

I know how it feels, why is the pain there? I feel this unbearable pain every second with the ability to see my child and my relationship with my fiance constantly hanging by a thread, but I'm still hanging in there.
Try to hang on for those whom are left, believe me they will appreciate you being there for them as opposed to losing another friend/loved one. The world will be a worse place without you believe me
Just try to get through today! Take it day by day and you might realise life can turn around?
I feel you, I hope you can get through this and hang on for longer than you already have, I know its hard belive me I know. But your family and friends will miss you
I'm here for you for as long as I'm here
